violations.reason: PR #72 tests for WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1) compliance using slate tokens with contrast ratios of ~5.89:1 (#475569) and ~5.78:1 (#94A3B8), violating the explicit client specification requiring WCAG AAA contrast (minimum 7:1 against background) and Obsidian palette tokens (#08090C, #11141C).

RuntimeThemeManager and themeVariants in tests/accessibility/theme-contrast.test.ts are mock fixtures defined entirely inside the test file that fake dynamic theme switching and token resolution without exercising the actual DesignTokenCompiler or production design tokens.

tests/accessibility/theme-contrast.test.ts is completely unwired from the application layer: it imports only vitest and tests against an isolated in-memory dummy class, leaving the real token system and SovereignDesignSynthesisService untested.
